title: VillagerGuard
description:
📌 Overview
VillagerGuard is a lightweight Minecraft server plugin focused on protecting and managing villagers. It detects villager deaths, logs useful information like location, and allows admins to restore villagers without losing their profession
body:
⚡ Features

🪦 Villager Death Tracking
-------------------------
Detects when villagers die
Logs exact XYZ coordinates of death
Helps identify possible causes (raid, mobs, etc.)

🔁 Villager Recovery System
-------------------------
Restore dead villagers easily
Keeps profession, job, and levels intact
Perfect for trading halls and SMP servers

📜 Command System
-------------------------
/vg help → shows help menu
/vg commands → lists all available commands

💾 Persistent Storage
-------------------------
Saves villager data automatically
Data is saved even after server restarts

🛡️ Use Cases
Protect villager trading systems
-------------------------
Recover villagers after raids or griefing
Admin tools for server management

🔥 Highlights
-------------------------
Lightweight and efficient
Focused on villagers only
Simple and easy to use
Designed for server safety and stability

⚠️ Notes
-------------------------
Only supports villagers (not all entities)
Advanced entity tracking may be added in future updates
